subagents.name: Test Automation Architect
subagents.description: Use this agent for UDC Test Automation ETE workflow orchestration, framework architecture, and step-by-step guidance on which specialist subagent to run next (JIRA vs plan-driven vs healing vs TCC test catalog). Routes to test-case-catalog skill for naming and Excel documentation.

subagents.name: Test Case Writer
subagents.description: Use this agent when you need to create Playwright test scripts from JIRA requirements. Fetches JIRA, runs the six-block requirements gate (posts a comment to the reporter via MCP if anything is missing—no test Write until the gate passes unless you explicitly override), then analyzes project patterns and generates Playwright tests per UDC conventions. Optional Step 8: apply test-case-catalog skill for TCC naming and Excel docs.

subagents.name: Playwright Test Generator
subagents.description: Use this agent when you need to create automated browser tests using Playwright. Generates robust, reliable Playwright tests that simulate user interactions and validate application behavior.

subagents.name: Playwright Test Healer
subagents.description: Use this agent to fix and heal broken Playwright tests. Analyzes test failures, identifies root causes, and applies fixes to make tests stable and reliable.

subagents.name: Playwright Test Planner
subagents.description: Use this agent to plan and organize Playwright test suites. Helps structure test plans, identify test coverage gaps, and organize tests effectively.
